# Copilot Instructions

- After every change made to the repository, add a human-readable diary entry to `JOURNAL.md` describing the change.
- Use a level-one heading for each day and a level-two heading with the time for every change entry. Use UTC for timestamps.
- Keep journal entries concise and include the files changed and any relevant validation performed.
- Do not commit or push changes automatically. Leave changes available for local verification unless the user explicitly asks for a commit or push.
- Whenever `supabase/schema.sql` changes, remind the user to run the updated SQL in the Supabase SQL Editor.
